text: Never buy Cupid's seven percent jump without reading this.
This morning, Cupid hit three hundred eighty one rupees. Up seven point six percent, to a fresh high.
The trigger? Results. Revenue more than doubled, to one hundred eighty eight crore. Profit, up one hundred thirty three percent.
But the small print: operating margin fell, from thirty four to twenty nine percent. And twenty one crore was other income, not sales.
The company promised eight hundred crore this year. Six months in, it's at three hundred forty three. The next six must bring four fifty seven.
My take? The growth is real. But at over three hundred times its profit, the price expects perfection.
Would you buy Cupid at this price? Comment CUPID, and follow for more.
